thread:
liz: Nightly adaptive kernel probe finished on the h100 pool. perf-bot posted the summary but quick heads-up: candidate k-57f shows ~6% lower p95 for seqlen=1024 single-stream, but we see a throughput drop for batch=8 on KV-heavy workloads.

omar: Reproduced locally. KV-cache miss rate spikes during beam search which correlates with the throughput drop. Reproducer: `scripts/repro_k57f.sh --seq 1024 --bs 8 --beams 4`

priya: Can we add a "kv-hot-prefix" microbench to the harness? Current microbench focuses on cold-start and pure streaming; we need a scenario that simulates repeated prefix + new tokens to exercise prefix cache churn.

dennis: Quick triage notes: k-57f is being preferred by the pick heuristic for seqlen>512 on both Ampere and H100 variants. The kernel has lower per-token latency but larger working set which increases KV eviction churn under batched beam workloads.

perf-bot: nightly-sweep report summary -> pool=h100-adaptive-3; candidates=[k-33b,k-57f,k-92c]; highlights: p50/p95 improved for k-57f on single-stream longseqlen; throughput regression (-9%) observed for bs=8, seqlen=1024 in kv-hot workload. Full CSV & perf artifacts: https://perf/reports/1765078901 (CI ID: rw-ci-1765) :eyes:

liz: Proposal: gate k-57f to single-stream canary only until we fix KV-churn behavior. Also add kv-hot-prefix test to perf CI and surface KV-hit-rate metric in the console for nightly scans.

omar: I'll open a PR to add the microbench + reproduce script into the harness and extend the nightly sweep to run kv-hot-prefix for bs in [1,4,8,16]. I'll include a perf-lab container image for quick repro.

priya: On heuristics: suggest adding a rule: if KV-hit-rate < 0.9 and batch_size >= 8 then prefer kernel with smaller resident working set (even if slightly worse p95 on single-stream). This should avoid the observed throughput tailspin.

dennis: Captured kernel-pick log snippet: ```[kpick] model=galactica-seq seq=1024 bs=8 candidate=k-57f kv_hit=0.63 reason=seqlen_threshold``` — that kv_hit number is the smoking gun.

liz: Sounds good. Action items: @omar -> PR for harness + microbench (due EOD tomorrow), @priya -> draft heuristic rule and unit tests, @dennis -> gating plan + rollout constraints (canary single-stream only). I'll file ticket RW-4342 and link artifacts. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: Created ticket RW-4342 and linked nightly artifacts. CI job rw-ci-1765 rerun scheduled in 2 hours with kv-hot-prefix enabled.

omar: Leaving notes in PR about expected delta: ~-9% throughput for bs=8 on kv-hot with k-57f, p95 improvement for single-stream longseqlen. Will add baseline comparisons and diff heatmaps.

priya: Also request we add a small synthetic to exercise beam-search KV invalidation pattern (beam size 4) so we catch these earlier in candidate gating.

dennis: I'll instrument the kpick logs to emit kv_hit_rate and selected_kernel tags to make the nightly dashboard filterable.

liz: Thanks everyone — let's converge on gating + microbench, we shouldn't promote k-57f to wide rollout until rw-4342 is resolved.
